questions.stem: A 4-day-old male infant presents to neonatal intensive care with jaundice that was noticed initially yesterday and gradually has increased. He was delivered at term with a 2.8kg birth weight. His family history is unremarkable. Physical examination revealed an actively jaundiced baby with a temperature of 36.2°C, HR= 156b/min, RR = 35/min. Examination of the eyes reveals a yellow sclera and the entire body is icteric. Total serum bilirubin was found to be 24mg/dl. The baby was started on phototherapy immediately till blood was arranged for exchange transfusion. All of the following are the side effects of exchange transfusion except?
